proof_body:
by
  intro f a hd hb h0 ha hne hn
  have hm : Set.MapsTo f (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.closedBall (f 0) (1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [h0]
    exact fun z hz => by simpa using (hb z hz).le
  have hs : ‖dslope f 0 a‖ = (1 : ℝ) / 1 := by
    rw [dslope_of_ne f hne, slope_def_module, h0]
    simp only [sub_zero, norm_smul, norm_inv, hn]
    field_simp [norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hne]
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hEq⟩ := Complex.affine_of_mapsTo_ball_of_exists_norm_dslope_eq_div' hd hm ⟨a, ha, hs⟩
  refine ⟨C, by simpa using hC, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have := hEq hz
  simpa [h0, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using this
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (a : ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball 0 1) → (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, ‖f z‖ < 1) → f 0 = 0 → a ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 → a ≠ 0 → ‖f a‖ = ‖a‖ → ∃ u : ℂ, ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, f z = u * z
